functions.name: GetOrCreateNetHandle
functions.docs: Returns an existing NetHandle for an object if it's present or creates one if it's not. Assumes Init() has been called.

functions.name: MakeNetHandleFromId
functions.docs: Returns a NetHandle given an Id that has previously been extracted from a valid NetHandle. The behavior is implementation defined if the Id was not extracted from a valid NetHandle.

functions.name: DestroyNetHandle
functions.docs: This class restricts access to DestroyNetHandle functionality as early destruction prevents further dirty state tracking.
